description: This is a unit test class for the LeaveCommentAPI in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It contains test methods for creating, retrieving, and validating leave comments API endpoints, as well as handling not found cases and unimplemented methods.

classes.name: LeaveCommentAPITest
classes.description: A test class for the LeaveCommentAPI, covering methods for creating, listing, validating, and handling edge cases for leave comment API endpoints.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestCommentService
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of the LeaveRequestCommentService instance from the API.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a leave comment via the API and verifies the response content.

methods.name: testCreateLeaveRecordNotFound
methods.description: Tests the behavior when the leave record is not found during comment creation.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates the creation request validation rules.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all leave comments for a specific leave request.

methods.name: testGetAllLeaveRecordNotFound
methods.description: Tests the behavior when the leave record is not found during get all comments.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates the get-all comments request validation rules.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that the delete method raises a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests that the getValidationRuleForDelete method raises a not implemented exception.
